developments.label: PHP: distinguish the initial pair from the follow-up
developments.summary: Captured CNA context marks the initial pair as PUBLISHED, each with CVSS 4.0 9.2 and captured KEV membership dated October 26. PHP’s October 21 notice lists upstream 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12 for the pair, while documenting distribution/LTS fixes and minimal backports for 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1. Displayed version alone does not establish patch status. The mod_php demonstration, other SAPI qualifications, and same-worker request-state prerequisites must remain distinct. The separate October 23 follow-up does not establish a shipped fix for CVE-2026-115560; its CNA attempt failed and its record state is UNKNOWN. The conditional upload-progress setting is not complete mitigation of the initial pair.

developments.label: Brotli: confirm downstream version applicability
developments.summary: The captured Google CNA record describes Brotli decoder memory-safety context and CVSS 4.0 9.2. Its affected ranges are 1.0.3 to below 1.0.10, 1.1.0 to below 1.1.1, and 1.2.0 to below 1.2.1. Check downstream product guidance rather than assuming every consumer shares an affected build or configuration. Captured KEV membership is separate from the date-only October 27 catalog-addition row, whose exact window membership is uncertain.

developments.label: Commerce: retain product-specific branch ranges
developments.summary: Adobe’s captured CNA record covers Commerce, Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source and Commerce Events, with separate affected and unaffected branch statements retained in data.json. It supplies CVSS 3.1 9.3. Preserve those branch strings rather than collapsing them into a universal patch threshold. The October 27 KEV-addition date is boundary-uncertain; captured KEV membership does not make it a main-window catalog addition.

developments.label: Moxa: separate client and gateway conditions
developments.summary: The captured CNA context separates MRC Client server-configuration validation from OnCell G3150A-LTE key and SMS-command conditions. MRC Client 1.0.0 through 4.2.0 is marked affected and 4.2.2 unaffected; the OnCell records list version 1.0.0 with affected default status. Their CVSS 4.0 scores are 7.6, 7.7 and 7.5. Two unavailable MRC guidance text fields remain null. Use the vendor advisory for exact applicability and handling.

developments.label: AWS API MCP Server: review token audience handling
developments.summary: The captured CNA record describes OAuth token audience validation in aws-api-mcp-server and marks 1.3.0 to below 1.6.0 affected, with CVSS 4.0 7.3. Loaded mitigation guidance remains needs-review: a structured affected range and a package-reference URL do not by themselves establish a tested remediation for a deployment. Follow the retained AWS and project advisories.

developments.label: EDK2: verify firmware applicability with suppliers
developments.summary: The captured TianoCore CNA record concerns EDK2 PXE-driver context, marks versions through edk2-stable202608 affected, and supplies CVSS 4.0 9.5. It does not establish which systems ship that code or a current OEM firmware fix. Loaded mitigation guidance is needs-review; consult the project advisory and the relevant system supplier.

steps.title: CISA conditional guidance - alert revised 2026-10-23
steps.detail: CISA advises temporary offline status when organizations cannot update immediately or continue using unsupported PHP 8.1 or earlier, until patched or updated. This is attributed guidance under those conditions, not a finding that every numerically older build is unpatched or unpatchable. The retained page does not establish its initial publication time.

steps.title: Separate PHP follow-up - notice published 2026-10-23
steps.detail: The initial-pair release list does not establish a fix for the later CVE-2026-115560. PHP described a next-regular-release plan and session.upload_progress.enabled=0 as an interim setting for an unusual path: php_binary or php_serialize switched to php through ini_set() before session_start(), with upload progress still enabled. That conditional measure is not complete mitigation of the initial pair. These sources do not establish a shipped third fix or historical CVE-registry absence.
